description:
Your BokehTi Campagnolo

THE LATEST EVOLUTION OF OUR UNIQUE MASON BOKEH Ti, WITH CONFIGURABLE CAMPAGNOLO BUILD OPTIONS AND CUSTOMISABLE FEATURES

The Bokeh Ti offers a world-leading finely detailed titanium frameset, welded and finished by a long-established, highly experienced maker in Tuscany, Italy. Features like 3D-printed titanium UDH dropouts make this one of the most exclusive and advanced titanium frames available. The Bokeh Ti is welded in small batches and is available on a pre-order basis only.

The BokehTi takes all the characteristics of our hugely popular award-winning aluminium Bokeh and adds the incredibly taut, propulsive titanium ride that is made possible by a full custom Italian tubeset made just for us by Dedacciai. This is our ultimate smooth, comfortable, fast, multi-terrain, continent-crossing, ultra endurance machine.

For the latest version of the BokehTi, we have chosen to keep all the bike's character and capability, whilst enhancing its smooth, fast, ground covering nature. Updated with T47, internal routing through the bottom bracket and cleanly out through the chain stays, with dedicated dynamo routing through the top tube, the routing is now very clean and practical.

This bicycle is designed for an engaging, spirited and dynamic ride across a hugely varied spectrum of surfaces and terrain.

All builds available for our Bokeh and Exposure models are also available for the BokehTi. Ask us to help you configure your dream specification.

MASON CUSTOM PROGRAMME

We love building individual bicycles for individual people. All MASON models are open to custom specification to suit the neds of each rider.

While your frame is being welded and carefully finished you also have the chance to specify a full ‘Mason Custom Build’, basing your finished bicycle on a choice of components from our various carefully chosen suppliers. Please contact us for further information on this process and to start your dream build.

Choose from a range of Campagnolo groupsets, including Super Record, Record and EKAR

Available with a choice of HUNT, DT Swiss and Campagnolo wheelsets in 700c or 650b. Other options available on request

Available with a choice of finishing kit from Deda, Ritchey or other brands upon request

Carbon MASON Penta microadjust seatpost and MASON Macro seatclamp

Can be fitted with the Mason Luminance Upgrade. The ultimate dynamo + lighting set-up for all-terrain and multi-surface adventures. See 'Accessories + Upgrades' for details.

Available with a choice of 650b and 700c tyres, from premium brands
